data.narrative:
Reliable Robotics is a Series C-stage Space & Aerospace company that has raised $300M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 7 private peers at similar or adjacent stages (Series B through D) and 5 public Space & Aerospace companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Two quantitative methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement to the $300M raised proxy, implying $510M. Peer-median analysis across 7 same-sector comparables yields a $2.0B median valuation, with a range of $1.1B to $8.0B; named peers include Sierra Space ($8.0B, Series C), Impulse Space ($4.3B, Series D), Apex Space ($2.3B, Series D), and Varda Space Industries ($1.6B, Series D). Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied because Reliable Robotics' revenue is not disclosed. The 5 public Space & Aerospace companies trade at a median 24.6x price-to-sales, but this multiple is unusable without a revenue figure.

Triangulating the two applicable methods produces a valuation range of $434M (low) to $2.3B (high), with a median of $1.3B. The wide spread reflects meaningful dispersion in peer valuations and uncertainty around Reliable Robotics' relative stage maturity within Series C. Revenue scale and contract visibility remain critical value drivers not captured in this analysis.
